# Orca settings audit (generated by tools/orca_import/audit_tabs.py)

Every setting on Orca's Process / Filament / Printer tabs (Tab.cpp, page and group as Orca shows them) and what PiggieSlicer has for it: `mapped` = the converter carries it to the 3.0 key shown (with its 3.0 category/option group, i.e. where our UI shows it); `structural` = used to build the vendor structure; `dropped` = left out on purpose; `same key, unmapped` = 3.0 has a setting of that name the converter does not map; `not mapped` = no mapping yet: 3.0 may have it under another name (closest names shown) or it has to be ported.

| tab | mapped | structural | dropped | same key, unmapped | not mapped |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Process | 180 | 9 | 7 | 1 | 181 |
| Filament | 47 | 17 | 1 | 1 | 31 |
| Printer | 33 | 4 | 5 | 0 | 66 |
